details:
People in certain groups should be denied access to the main group instances that the owner has certain groups blocked. 

Basically, they can't join the instance unless they are not in that group. Or unless the main group that the player uses doesn't have that group blocked.

> example: potato group: I host it and I don't want "insert bad group here" to join: I simply block that group from the groups page and then their members can't join. 

The thing people worry about with this is that this is less likely to impact the player base on vrchat. people will be able to play with an ease of mind knowing that people won't cause problems.

avatar global group instance hiding. this is an admin staff moderation thing that I thought of:

you would open your menu and click on a player's collider. You would then scroll down above the warn, kick, force mute, and ban buttons there would be this hide avatar in instance. < instance global hide (I'm struggling to find a button name)

What that would do is when any player joins the instance with that avatar it would globally hide that avatar for everyone that way it would prevent crashers from crashing everyone in the instance. This would be a major fix for a lot of groups where crashers join their instances to shut them down.

it's like that hide avatar globally on your side but for group instances and it's only hidden for everyone that is in that instance. 

it's a pretty smart moderation to add.

the avatar hiding would reset with each instance or if the devs wanted it would keep hiding them until the button is pressed again.

> example: I am hanging out with my friends, and a crasher joins and a few players actually have their shield set to none. They almost crash but I press "hide avatar instance" and it hides that crashers avatar for everyone and no one crashes.
title: Group safety features. Please read. Contains Simple Examples.
